in_marathi.name: Gungun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sound of bells
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gungun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gungun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gung', which means the sound of bells. This name is associated with the goddess Parvati, who is believed to ring bells as a sign of her divine presence.
